title: Sync status can crash before returning search-index remediation
description: Evidence: buildSyncStatus wraps ledgers with safeLedgerStatus but calls inspectSearchIndex directly; inspectSearchIndex computes expected fingerprints from store state before its local metadata try/catch. Impact: malformed object/search state can make sync status throw instead of returning structured unhealthy searchIndex status and repair commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync status wraps search-index inspection in a safe result path equivalent to ledgers.
Malformed store/search fixtures return ok=false with recommended repair actions rather than uncaught exceptions.
